subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Is the linked PR's WebChat notice-on-reconnect behavior sufficient to resolve this issue, or should maintainers require deferral or immediate user-message persistence as part of the same fix?
rationale: The issue names three acceptable directions, while the open PR implements the notice path only; deciding whether that is sufficient defines the recovery contract users will see after a restart.

options.title: Accept notice path
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if its transcript write is safe, then close this issue as fixed by the visible unresumable notice.

options.title: Require stronger recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open after the notice work and require a follow-up that prevents the message or turn from becoming unrecoverable.

recommendation.title: Accept notice path
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if its transcript write is safe, then close this issue as fixed by the visible unresumable notice.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses delivery-mirror behavior and restart deferral, both areas with prior history from this owner candidate.
